reports.title: A10 Networks Reports Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2026

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Based on year-to-date performance, demand visibility and the current supply environment, management is updating its full-year 2026 outlook to the following:
•Full-year revenue growth of approximately 16%, compared to prior guidance of 12-14% full-year growth.
•Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA margin in excess of 30%.
•Non-GAAP diluted EPS of between $1.08 - $1.10, representing growth of 20-22% over 2025 and exceeding the revenue growth rate, compared to prior guidance of 14-16% EPS growth.
